appraisal_events.evidence: un homme de génie peut être le cousin d'une vieille bête... il n'y a pas de supplice que je ne m'imposerais pour que la vieille bête me présentât à l'auteur de la sonate
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann declares he would endure any torment to be introduced to the composer of the sonata, expressing intense reverence for the genius he takes him to be.

appraisal_events.evidence: Le peintre avait entendu dire que Vinteuil était menacé d'aliénation mentale. Et il assurait qu'on pouvait s'en apercevoir à certains passages de sa sonate.
appraisal_events.explanation: The painter relays hearsay that Vinteuil is threatened with mental derangement and claims signs of it are audible in his sonata, casting a troubling shadow over the very genius Swann has just praised.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's declared willingness to suffer any torment to meet him casts Vinteuil as a revered genius.
The reported threat of mental derangement, allegedly perceptible in his sonata, locally tarnishes the image of the admired composer.
Swann is troubled by the painter's remark rather than dismissing it, showing it unsettles his esteem for the composer he reveres.
